description: Nested scopes and subqueries: a CTE body reads its own derived tables, LATERAL subqueries and WITH clause and the CTEs declared before it, with a star over an earlier CTE; a derived table and its set operation branches read the CTEs of the enclosing WITH clause; each arm of a set operation keeps its own derived tables; column lists rename a derived table's, a VALUES list's and a CTE's (over a star) columns, a shorter list keeping the rest; a scalar subquery takes its column's type and name, and a parameter compared with one takes its type; a NULL in the first branch takes the later branches' type.
